arguments.name: minted-version
arguments.source:
(lambda (input)
  "Return the highest version number minted in INPUT. A version is minted
only by a line containing `Created version <n> of <name>.` -- digits, then
`of`, then a name of non-space/non-period chars, then a literal period.
When a component is re-created, the latest minted version is in force, so
the max across all minting lines is returned. Returns \"none\" if no line
mints."
  (let ((best -1) (found nil))
    (with-input-from-string (s input)
      (loop for line = (read-line s nil)
            while line
            do (let ((p (search "Created version " line)))
                 (when p
                   (let* ((q (+ p (length "Created version ")))
                          (sp (position #\Space line :start q)))
                     (when sp
                       (let ((digits (subseq line q sp)))
                         (when (every #'digit-char-p digits)
                           (let* ((r (1+ sp))
                                  (ofp (search "of " line :start2 r)))
                             (when (and ofp (= ofp r))
                               (let* ((name-start (+ r 3))
                                      (dot (position #\. line :start name-start)))
                                 (when dot
                                   (let ((name (subseq line name-start dot)))
                                     (when (and (plusp (length name))
                                                (every (lambda (c) (and (char/= c #\Space) (char/= c #\.))) name))
                                       (setf found t
                                             best (max best (parse-integer digits)))))))))))))))))
    (if found (format nil "~a" best) "none")))
arguments.note: Extract latest minted version from a tool reply per the exact minting grammar
